product_summary: Caesarstone Calacatta Maximus is a premium engineered quartz countertop that mimics Calacatta marble with soft greige veining and gold accents on a white background. It offers the durability and low maintenance of engineered quartz while delivering the luxury aesthetic of natural marble. Strong performance credentials are overshadowed by corporate instability and ongoing litigation.

beats_expectations: Lifetime transferable warranty for residential use
No sealer maintenance required unlike natural stone
underperforms_expectations: Heat damage from hot cookware excluded despite quartz marketing as heat-resistant
Seam appearance and performance completely excluded from coverage
surprises: Must use Caesarstone-certified fabricator or warranty is void
All labor, removal, and reinstallation costs excluded even for covered defects
Corporate financial instability raises questions about warranty backing

buyer_considerations.text: Company facing 618 silicosis lawsuits and solvency warnings - lifetime warranty backing uncertain
Seam appearance excluded from warranty despite being visible design element in most installations
Heat damage from cookware is permanent and non-repairable - trivets required despite heat-resistant marketing

serviceability_summary: National fabricator network provides adequate coverage, but corporate instability could disrupt long-term support and warranty backing
material_health_summary: GREENGUARD Gold certified for low emissions with quartz particles safely encapsulated in resin matrix - no consumer health risks in installed product despite fabrication dust concerns
